name: std::set<Key,Compare,Allocator>::value_comp
intro: Returns the function object that compares the values. It is the same as key_comp.

examples.output:
Key (1) goes before key (100)
Key (2) goes before key (100)
Key (3) equivalent to key (100)
Key (4) goes after key (100)
